blocks.text: Eleven terms carry a specific meaning in this report, and thirty-nine documents support it, cited by the date on their covers.

Abbreviations are listed in the front matter. Footnotes cite each deliverable by a short title, keyed below; the table gives its full title and the date printed on its cover, and where the file date differs, both are shown. Working analyses rank below the deliverables. Wesgro's, the province's and the City's own documents are cited directly by page, slide or chapter. Other public sources are used only where no deliverable carries the figure.
